"""

from scapy.all import rdpcap, Raw
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers import Cipher, algorithms, modes
from cryptography.hazmat.backends import default_backend

def parse_keys(log_file):
    keys = {}

        for line in f:
            if line.startswith('CLIENT_RANDOM'):
                parts = line.strip().split()
                client_random = parts[1]
                master_secret = parts[2]
                keys[client_random] = master_secret
    return keys

keys = parse_keys('vcheck.log')
print("Clés trouvées:")
for cr, ms in keys.items():
    print(f"  ClientRandom: {cr[:16]}... -> MasterSecret: {ms[:16]}...")

# Trouver les paquets TLS Application Data (type 0x17)

tls_records = []
for i, pkt in enumerate(packets):
    if Raw in pkt:
        raw = bytes(pkt[Raw].load)
        # Vérifier si c'est du TLS (Content Type en premier octet)

{"code": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Analyser le Server Hello pour trouver le cipher suite
"""
from scapy.all import rdpcap, Raw

packets = rdpcap('capture.pcapng')

# Chercher le Server Hello (dans les paquets TLS)
for i, pkt in enumerate(packets):
    if Raw in pkt:
        raw = bytes(pkt[Raw].load)
        if len(raw) >= 5:
            content_type = raw[0]
            # TLS Handshake (22)
            if content_type == 0x16:
                # Vérifier si c'est un Server Hello
                # TLS Record: Type(1) + Version(2) + Length(2) + Handshake Type(1) + ...
                if len(raw) >= 10:
                    handshake_type = raw[5]
                    if handshake_type == 0x02:  # Server Hello
                        print(f"Paquet {i}: Server Hello")
                        print(f"  Raw (hex): {raw[:50].hex()}")
                        # Le Server Hello contient le cipher suite à offset 43 dans le handshake
                        # Structure: Handshake Type(1) + Length(3) + Version(2) + Random(32) + Session ID len(1) + Session ID + Cipher Suite(2) + Compression(1)
                        # Après le header TLS (5 bytes) + handshake type (1) + handshake length (3)
                        offset = 5 + 1 + 3  # 9 bytes pour aller au début du Server Hello body
                        version = raw[offset:offset+2]
                        random = raw[offset+2:offset+34]
                        session_id_len = raw[offset+34]
                        session_id = raw[offset+35:offset+35+session_id_len]
                        cipher_suite_offset = offset + 35 + session_id_len
                        cipher_suite = raw[cipher_suite_offset:cipher_suite_offset+2]
                        print(f"  Version: {version.hex()}")
                        print(f"  Random: {random.hex()}")
                        print(f"  Session ID len: {session_id_len}")
                        print(f"  Cipher Suite: {cipher_suite.hex()}")
                        break", "timeout": 30}

def get_client_random_from_client_hello(raw):
    # Client Hello: Handshake Type(1) + Length(3) + Version(2) + Random(32) + ...
    # Après header TLS (5 bytes) + handshake type (1) + handshake length (3)
    offset = 5 + 1 + 3
    if len(raw) >= offset + 34:
        return raw[offset:offset+32]
    return None

# Extraire le Server Random du Server Hello
def get_server_random_from_server_hello(raw):
    offset = 5 + 1 + 3
    if len(raw) >= offset + 34:
        return raw[offset:offset+32]
    return None

for i, pkt in enumerate(packets):
    if Raw in pkt:
        raw = bytes(pkt[Raw].load)

def extract_session_info(packets):

                    # Le Server Hello contient aussi le Client Random? Non, juste Server Random
                    # Mais on peut mapper par ordre: premier Server Hello correspond au premier Client Hello
                    pass
    
    # Mapper les sessions: on suppose que les Client Hello et Server Hello sont appariés par ordre
    client_hellos = sorted(client_hello_info.items(), key=lambda x: x[1])
    
    # Trouver les Server Hellos
    server_hellos = {}
    for i, pkt in enumerate(packets):

            if len(raw) >= 5 and raw[0] == 0x16 and raw[5] == 0x02:

        # Trouver le Server Hello suivant
        for sh_time, sr in sorted(server_hellos.items()):
            if sh_time > ch_time:
                session_info.append((cr, sr, ch_time, sh_time))
                del server_hellos[sh_time]
